parameters.query:
UPDATE teachers_manager.ai_rate_limiter
SET last_request_at = now()
WHERE id = 1
  AND (last_request_at IS NULL OR now() - last_request_at >= ($1 || ' seconds')::interval)
RETURNING last_request_at;

INSERT INTO teachers_manager.ai_usage_daily (teacher_id, usage_date, request_count)
VALUES ($1::uuid, CURRENT_DATE, 1)
ON CONFLICT (teacher_id, usage_date)
DO UPDATE SET request_count = teachers_manager.ai_usage_daily.request_count + 1
WHERE teachers_manager.ai_usage_daily.request_count < $2
RETURNING request_count;

parameters.query:
SELECT c.content, c.chapter_title, c.page_number, c.book_id, b.title AS book_title
FROM teachers_manager.book_chunks c
JOIN teachers_manager.book_sources b ON b.id = c.book_id
WHERE c.teacher_id = $1::uuid
  AND b.status = 'ready'
  AND (
    $2::uuid IS NULL
    OR NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teachers_manager.book_student_links l WHERE l.book_id = b.id)
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM teachers_manager.book_student_links l WHERE l.book_id = b.id AND l.student_id = $2::uuid)
  )
ORDER BY c.embedding <=> $3::vector
LIMIT $4::integer;
